task_definition.task_description: Please reserve 2 Apple AirPods for me, turn that selection into cart items, check my available coupons, and apply the best discount before placing the order with my credit card. After that, clear the AirPods from my cart, prepare an invoice for emailing to user@example.com, then go ahead with the best recommended electronics checkout for 1 black Sony XM5, get the current prices for BTC and AAPL, and finally save a short note titled “Shopping and Market Snapshot” summarizing the checkout, invoice prep, recommendation order, and market quotes.

user_input.query: Please help me with a shopping flow for user_123 in the electronics category: reserve quantity 2 of p_apple_airpods, convert that selection into cart items, check my available coupons, and apply the best discount, including coupon code SAVE15 if eligible, before placing the order using stripe with my credit_card. After checkout, clear the AirPods from my cart so the post-checkout cart quantity is 0, and prepare an invoice to email to user@example.com. Then proceed with the best recommended electronics checkout for quantity 1 of p_sony_xm5_blk. Also get the current prices for BTC and AAPL. Finally, save a short note titled Shopping and Market Snapshot with the content: “Initial checkout completed, invoice payload prepared, recommendation order processed, and market quotes captured.” Please tag it with shopping, finance, and audit.
user_input.document_content: Initial checkout completed, invoice payload prepared, recommendation order processed, and market quotes captured.
